summary: Bloom Peak L-4 lookout site, Sanders County MT / Shoshone County ID (sources differ): built 1932, abandoned 1943; a little concrete and gravel or a rock foundation remains.

facts.design: L-4 cab (register says it 'may have been'; firelookout.com says L-4 cab); the Idaho Fire Lookouts site describes a 30-foot L-4 tower
facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1943 and removed; the register notes a little concrete and gravel remain

visit.trail_note: No lookout structure remains to climb. The Idaho Fire Lookouts site lists the site as drive-up.

notes_for_editor: Location, forest and elevation conflict. The register (US 2058, MT 9) places the site in the Kootenai National Forest, Sanders County, Montana, at 5,863 ft, matching the record's elevation_m 1787 and coordinates. Firelookout.com gives the same 5,863 ft but says Shoshone County, Idaho/Sanders County, Montana, on the Coeur d'Alene/Kootenai forests. The Idaho Fire Lookouts site gives 4,932 ft and the Coeur d'Alene National Forest, and it lists a 30-foot L-4 tower. The record's kind 'ground' follows the register's wording ('may have been an L-4 cab'). The register hedges the design, so no correction is proposed. Staffing is unknown. The Idaho site has no staffing history, and no other staffing source was found. The 'removed after 1943' wording is vague; the year 1943 in the event list is the register's bound, not a confirmed removal date. No access statement from the Forest Service was found; the Idaho site's 'Drive-Up' label is the only access evidence. The Idaho site's photo ('Photo circa 2011') has no licence given, so no photo is proposed. The Montana state listing (firelookout.org/lookouts/us/mt/) was checked for the Bloom Peak line and lists it with 'Sanders/Shoshone (ID)'.
